_note: Preloaded DEFAULT (factory) colours for colourable leather-based armour, keyed by Hypixel item id. A piece showing its default colour is NOT exotic. These seed the detector so it works immediately, before it has learned defaults from scanning. The crawler still learns/refines defaults empirically (piece_colors table) — learned values win once confident. Hex lowercase, no '#'. Verified values are included; sets without a confirmed value are intentionally omitted (the learner fills those in). _vanillaLeather is the undyed fallback for any leather piece with no entry.
